_comment: Place this file as .mcp.json in your project root for Claude Code to pick it up automatically. Alternatively, register via CLI: claude mcp add flexibee /path/to/flexibee-mcp --env FLEXIBEE_URL=https://your-flexibee-host:5434 --env FLEXIBEE_USERNAME=api-user --env FLEXIBEE_PASSWORD_FILE=/path/to/.flexibee-password
